I need to check Robert Walsh's case since he has two workspace memberships—admin on one, member on another—against what the runtime_qualifications actually specify.

This exposes a real conflict: users.info is documented to expose only one workspace association per user for reproducibility, but Robert Walsh having two user_teams rows makes it ambiguous which one gets surfaced. That directly violates the stated requirement to give each queried person a single workspace membership for reproducible profile predicates.

This confirms the access defect: the access_plan assumes users.info exposes a single association for discrimination purposes, but if the API can arbitrarily expose either membership, the solver can't reliably rule out the alternate answer, directly violating the runtime qualification's reproducibility guarantee. So the verdict here is a validity fail due to this access issue.
